claims.statement: The Republic described Tom Allen as an ex-champion in June 1886.
claims.excerpt: PRIZE-FIGHTER TOM ALLEN, ex-champion, bet on Cuban Queen

claims.statement: Tom Allen bet on the horse Cuban Queen at the St. Louis races, because her father was named Strathmore.
claims.excerpt: PRIZE-FIGHTER TOM ALLEN, ex-champion, bet on Cuban Queen—because her father was named Strathmore.

notes: Race date inferred from 'yesterday' in the column (paper dated 1886-06-16). Other lines concern other people.
